ticket.title: Billing "Create bill / Add bill items" workspace doesn't show which patient is being billed
ticket.text:
Billing "Create bill / Add bill items" workspace doesn't show which patient is being billed

Repo: openmrs-esm-billing-app (1.4.0)

Found on: test3 (3.8.0-rc.1), 2026-10-13 at 768×1024. Patient: Grace QA380-H4 (10001MJ).

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open a patient chart at tablet width (768 px) → Billing history → Create bill.
2. Or, from an invoice page (`/home/billing/patient/{patientUuid}/{billUuid}`), choose Add items to bill.
3. Look for the patient's name and OpenMRS ID on screen.

### Actual

- The billing workspace covers the screen on tablet and shows no patient name or identifier.
- From the invoice page, the page's own patient banner (`src/invoice/invoice.component.tsx:226`) is covered by the workspace on tablet.
- A cashier switching between patients can't confirm whose bill they're adding items to.

### Expected

The workspace shows the patient's name and identifier (ideally the compact patient banner) at the top, on every screen size.

### Cause and fix

- `src/billing-form/billing-form.workspace.tsx:271-285`: `<Workspace2 …>` renders the bill form with no patient header. The workspace already receives `patientUuid` (lines 57-58).
- Fix: follow the Dispensing pattern (`openmrs-esm-dispensing-app` `src/forms/dispense-form.workspace.tsx:67,344`). Load the patient with `usePatient(patientUuid)` and render `<ExtensionSlot name="patient-header-slot" state={{ patient, patientUuid, hideActionsOverflow: true }} />` as the first child of the form.
